question: Will Nvidia's anchor investment in Anthropic's IPO be publicly confirmed before October 2, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Only source is Reuters' Sept 11 anonymous-sourced report; both companies declined or did not comment, and nothing on the record has emerged in the 10 days since. EDGAR shows no public S-1 — the June 1 draft remains confidential — so the question is live, not pre-resolved. The dominant YES path is a public S-1 before Oct 1 that names Nvidia as a cornerstone/anchor; the prospectus has already slipped from the week of Sept 5 to 'late September', and WSJ's Sept 18 reporting points to a November listing with a mid-October-at-earliest roadshow, implying a public filing more likely in early-to-mid October (~30% before Oct 1). Conditional on filing, disclosure of a firm Nvidia IPO commitment is maybe ~40% — talks were called preliminary and cornerstone deals typically firm up just before launch. Anthropic's quiet period and gun-jumping caution make a standalone press release or on-record spokesperson confirmation unlikely, and Nvidia has no scheduled filing before Oct 1 (~3% residual). Kalshi's nearest contract (IPO announcement before Oct 1, ~4c on Sept 5) resolves on different terms but corroborates that little is expected to land publicly this month.
